name: uikit
description: Project-aware onboarding and UI skills: a single map (docs/map.md) and a router (/uikit:what) that names your next step, an optional /uikit:setup that records the project’s system, stack, and flows once, defining the system as a live /uikit/design-system route in the project’s own stack, prototyping features as flow definitions rendered at /uikit/flows from the real components, and implementing them natively without design-system drift.
